preview.text: Canterbury won the toss and chose to bowl first against the Central Stags in their one-day match at McLean Park. The usual first-innings score in the 21 recorded one-day matches at this venue is 270. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 41 per cent chance of rain and a temperature of about 28 degrees.

summary.text: Canterbury won the match by 2 wickets after limiting their opponents to 129-10, where Angus Schaw was the top scorer with 35 off 59 balls and Matt Rowe took 3 for 17. In reply, Canterbury reached 130-8 with Mitchell Hay scoring 28 off 32 balls, despite Josh Clarkson claiming 5 for 30.
